dialogues.speaker: Records
dialogues.text: (These notes seem to have been plundered during a recent raid on the Fatui. The search might have been too rough — the page is torn in several places, making it hard to read.)

dialogues.speaker: Records
dialogues.text: "Before we withdrew, we should have divided the Arsenal Key into three parts: one for the Inspector, one for the Armory Officer, and one to be left in Tatarasuna itself to prevent theft."

dialogues.speaker: Records
dialogues.text: "But we were in too much of a hurry, and neither the Inspector nor the Armory Officer could be found, so I was so bold as to hide the three pieces within treasure chests in Tatarasuna..."
